caption: The drawing features a detailed, monochromatic rendering of a teapot, prominently centered and occupying the upper section of the composition. The teapot exhibits a broad, rounded body, a tall decorative lid with a pointed finial, a long curved spout on the left, and an ornate handle on the right, all depicted in shades of grey and black pencil. Below the main illustration, three smaller rectangular drawings are arranged horizontally: on the left, a close-up detail of the spout, in the center, a circular top-down schematic labeled "lid," and on the right, a close-up detail of the handle attachment. The entire composition is enclosed within simple rectangular borders. The artist's name, "Francis Law Durand," is inscribed in the bottom right corner of the paper.
title: Silver Teapot
